name: consular_case_types
description: Consular case types available in the demo. default_sla_days is a calendar-day budget for the case from intake to resolution, and pauses while the case is in AWAITING_CITIZEN (see docs/workflows.md). classification is the zone a case of this type is created in and is never lowered automatically (ADR-0006). requires_human_determination marks case types whose resolution constitutes a consular determination and therefore may never be made autonomously by an AI system (BUILD_BIBLE.md section 6) - for those types the consular_triage Gateway purpose may only ever produce a proposal for a human to accept or reject.
sla_note: SLA values are DEMO DEFAULTS chosen to produce a realistic ageing distribution on the consular dashboard. They are not published service standards and must be confirmed against the mission's actual commitments before any non-demo use. Tracked as Q-15 in docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md.

case_types.label: Passport Renewal
case_types.description: Renewal of a national passport for a citizen resident in or travelling through the receiving state. Involves identity verification, biometric capture and issuance. HERO CASE TYPE - the demo's synthetic case is a passport renewal for a Nigerian student in Australia, tying the consular thread to the skilled-migration narrative.
case_types.sla_basis: Three-week budget reflecting identity verification plus production and return of the document.

case_types.label: Emergency Travel Document
case_types.description: Issuance of a single-use travel document to a citizen who is stranded, whose passport has been lost or stolen, or who must travel urgently. Requires identity satisfaction on reduced evidence, which is precisely why it is a determination and not an administrative step.
case_types.sla_basis: Urgency is the point of the product; a budget longer than 48 hours defeats it.

case_types.label: Notarial Services and Document Attestation
case_types.description: Authentication and legalisation of documents, affidavits, powers of attorney and certified copies. The consular officer attests to authenticity, which is a determination carrying legal effect.
case_types.sla_basis: Allows for appointment scheduling, verification against issuing authorities, and return of originals.

case_types.label: Citizen Welfare Check
case_types.description: Response to a request - often from family - to establish the wellbeing and whereabouts of a citizen. Requires judgement about privacy, consent to disclose, and the appropriate level of intervention.
case_types.sla_basis: Short budget: welfare concerns degrade quickly, and the initial contact attempt is the critical step.

case_types.label: Birth Registration Abroad
case_types.description: Registration of the birth of a citizen's child in the receiving state, establishing civil status and the basis for citizenship documentation. A determination about entitlement, not a filing exercise.
case_types.sla_basis: Two weeks to allow verification of parental documentation and civil-registry processing.

case_types.label: Visa Enquiry and Referral
case_types.description: An enquiry about entry to the receiving state. The mission does not decide the receiving state's visa matters, so no determination is made - the case is answered with accurate information and, where appropriate, referred to the competent authority. The ONLY case type in this taxonomy with requires_human_determination false, precisely because nothing is being determined.
case_types.sla_basis: A working week to research and respond accurately; there is no external processing dependency.

case_types.label: Death of a National Abroad
case_types.description: Response to the death of a citizen in the receiving state: verification, next-of-kin notification, liaison with local authorities, and assistance with repatriation or local arrangements. Among the most sensitive matters a mission handles, and involves determinations about identity, notification and eligibility for assistance.
case_types.sla_basis: Initial response budget of one day. Total case duration is necessarily longer and driven by external authorities; the SLA measures the mission's own responsiveness, not the whole matter.

case_types.label: Detention or Arrest Notification
case_types.description: Notification that a citizen has been detained or arrested, and the arrangement of consular access. Time-critical: consular access rights attach on notification and are weakened by delay. Involves determinations about the citizen's wishes regarding contact and disclosure to family.
case_types.sla_basis: One day, reflecting the urgency of establishing consular access after notification.
